conversion_needs: Mole fraction of N2 is printed x10^4: stored value must be multiplied by 1e-4. Basis (mole fraction in the whole liquid, salt as undissociated species or ions) is not stated.
Pressure psia to MPa (x 0.00689476); pressure is total pressure with no correction for water vapour (stated for water, Table 2 text), whether this holds for the salt solutions is not stated.
Temperature given only as 30 C (303.15 K); temperature scale not stated.
Temperature 30 C is stated in the table title, not in a column.
notes: Salt-free. Authors state Henry's law holds in the studied range and no pressure correction for water vapour was applied.
